def Aeneas.Std.Array.update.{u} : {α : Type u} →
  {n : Aeneas.Std.Usize} → Aeneas.Std.Array α n → Aeneas.Std.Usize → α → Aeneas.Std.Result (Aeneas.Std.Array α n) :=
fun {α} {n} v i x =>
  match v[i]? with
  | none => Aeneas.Std.Result.fail Aeneas.Std.Error.arrayOutOfBounds
  | some val => Aeneas.Std.Result.ok ⟨(↑v).set (↑i) x, ⋯⟩
def Aeneas.Std.Array.index_mut_usize.{u} : {α : Type u} →
  {n : Aeneas.Std.Usize} →
    Aeneas.Std.Array α n → Aeneas.Std.Usize → Aeneas.Std.Result (α × (α → Aeneas.Std.Array α n)) :=
fun {α} {n} v i => do
  let x ← v.index_usize i
  Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (x, v.set i)

  {n : Aeneas.Std.Usize} → Aeneas.Std.Array α n → Aeneas.Std.Usize → Aeneas.Std.Result α :=
fun {α} {n} v i =>
  match v[i]? with
  | none => Aeneas.Std.Result.fail Aeneas.Std.Error.arrayOutOfBounds
